title: Why the backtest steps in time and vectorizes symbols
summary: Time advances bar by bar so cash, holdings, and settlement stay correct. Inside each bar, symbols are vectorized with NumPy and Numba. Window isolation is a separate card.
narrative:
The backtest engine advances along the trading schedule one step at a time. Cash, holdings, and settlement rules such as T+1 need that order. Inside a single step, buy/sell amounts, fees, and position updates run as array work across the asset pool (NumPy plus Numba-accelerated helpers such as backtest_step and batch steppers).

Optimization can use a leaner path (backtest_flash_steps) that keeps less intermediate state per parameter set. That is still the same step-in-time model, not a full-timeline matrix rewrite.

How the engine keeps each step from seeing future bars is the lookahead-isolation card. Signal-number meanings (PT versus PS/VS) and blender mixing stay on the strategy cards. This card does not compare third-party vector backtesters.
